Building Azeroth is a video series that explores the development and storytelling behind World of Warcraft. It features insights from developers, including Lead Cinematic Narrative Designer Terran Gregory, who discuss the creation of iconic moments in the game. One notable episode focuses on The Wrathgate, the first fully in-game cinematic added to the game, which set a precedent for future storytelling in the game. The series dives into the technical challenges Blizzard faced, such as developing tools for cinematic camera movement and coordinating NPC actions to create immersive scenes.

enjoying a burger.]] Burgers, otherwise known as patties, are a vital food item, typically created by goblins. Primarily cooked on a grill then sandwiched between two pieces of bread and topped with various accoutrements, the mighty burger possesses the unique skill of rallying even beleaguered peons to work beyond their limitations. Burgers were initially mentioned in the original World of Warcraft, wherein the beggar Topper McNabb requested one in exchange for a promise of later repayment. They were first introduced as an item in , where the :Warp Burger recipe could be crafted. This was later accompanied by the addition of the :Juicy Bear Burger recipe.
